scripts.text:
[Canell]
It's well known that we must
be beautiful to captivate those
who watch us dance. But to rely
on just our outward appearance
is a ghastly waste of our full
potential as performers.
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
眾所周知，我們必須美麗，才能迷住觀看我們舞蹈的人。
但僅僅依賴外表，是對我們作為表演者全部潛力的可怕浪費。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Yes, I can tell that you
don't quite understand that
the correct frame of mind is
an essential element to true
beauty. Now tell me, are you
confident in your dancing...?
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
是的，我能看出你並不完全理解，正確的心態是真正美麗的必要要素。
現在告訴我，你對自己的舞蹈有自信嗎...？

scripts.text: Of course, old crone!
scripts.translation: 當然，老太婆！

scripts.text: I... I'm not sure...
scripts.translation: 我...我不太確定...

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Ho-ho~ I believe you've
confused confidence with
arrogance! The naive cannot
tell there's a vitally important distinction between the two.
Now... Prepare for punishment!
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
呵呵~ 我相信你把自信和傲慢搞混了！
天真的人無法分辨這兩者之間至關重要的區別。
現在...準備接受懲罰吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ow...!
Th-that whip!
I-i-it huuuurts!

[Canell]
Awareness of your own flaws
and faults is the first crucial
step towards improvement.
Yet your obvious neglect of
your gift of dancing is...
grounds for punishment!
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
意識到自己的缺陷和錯誤，是邁向進步的關鍵第一步。
然而，你顯然忽視了你舞蹈的天賦，這就是...懲罰你的理由！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the...? Ack!
S-stop wh-whipping
me! It... It stiiings!

[Canell]
Ho-ho~! Fortunately for
you, I will teach you what
you must learn to rise above
your current limitations. When
I'm finished with you, angels and demons won't resist your charms~
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
呵呵~！幸運的是，我會教你必須學習的東西，以超越你目前的侷限。
當我教完你之後，天使和惡魔都無法抗拒你的魅力~

scripts.text: No way, you're not teaching me!
scripts.translation: 沒門，我才不學！

scripts.text: Alright, I'll see what I can learn.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我看看能學到什麼

scripts.text:
[Canell]
So... You still haven't
mastered the fine art of
exuding charm and humility!
There must be consequences
for this blatant affront to our
profession! Prepare yourself!
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
所以...你還沒有掌握散發魅力和謙遜的精髓！
這種對我們職業的公然冒犯必須付出代價！
準備接受懲罰吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nooooo--!
Not that whip
again! Arrgh, it's--
It hurts so much!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不——！
又是那條鞭子！
啊，好——
好痛！

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Ho-ho~ It's good that you
recognize that you have much
to learn. Well, let's not waste
any time. Your first lesson will be on image training and self
visualization. Now, for that...
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
呵呵~ 很好，你認識到自己還有很多要學的。
那麼，別浪費時間了。你的第一課是形象訓練和自我想像。
現在，為了這個...

scripts.text:
[Canell]
...You must bring
me ^FF00001 Crystal Mirror^000000!
This tool is imperative
to the lesson, so fetch it
and bring it to me quickly!
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
...你必須給我帶^FF00001個水晶鏡子^000000！
這個工具對課程至關重要，所以快去拿，然後馬上帶給我！

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Finally, you've come
with the mirror. Now,
look deeply and scrutinize
your reflection. Gaze upon
each blemish and fault, each
charming trait of your face.
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
終於，你帶著鏡子來了。現在，仔細審視你的倒影。凝視每一個瑕疵和缺點，以及你臉上每一個迷人的特徵。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
No face is perfect, but
know that your face is yours
alone, and that it is what gives you a beauty that can be no
one else's. Now, repeat
these truisms after me...
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
沒有完美的臉，但要知道，你的臉只屬於你，正是它賦予了你獨一無二的美麗。現在，跟著我重複這些真理...

scripts.text:
[Canell]
''I am beautiful...
I am irresistable...''
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
“我是美麗的...
我是不可抗拒的...”

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am beautiful...
I am irresistable...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是美麗的...
我是不可抗拒的...

scripts.text:
[Intoxicated Canell]
Louder!
More feeling!
''I am beautiful!
I am irresistable!
I am the most attractive
woman in the whole world!''
scripts.translation:
[陶醉的卡內爾]
大聲點！
更有感情！
“我是美麗的！
我是不可抗拒的！
我是世界上最迷人的女人！”

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am beautiful!
I am irresistable!
I am the most attractive
woman in the whole world!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是美麗的！
我是不可抗拒的！
我是世界上最迷人的女人！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYour self esteem has
sky rocketed. Fortunately,
you've managed to avoid
becoming a prima donna.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你的自信心直線上升。幸運的是，你還沒有變成那種難伺候的公主。^000000

scripts.text:
[Frustrated Canell]
Did I tell you to come
back here without bringing
^FF00001 Crystal Mirror^000000!? Now go
and get it before I find
reason to punish you!
scripts.translation:
[沮喪的卡內爾]
我讓你回來時帶上^FF00001個水晶鏡子^000000了嗎！？
現在快去把它拿來，否則我就找理由懲罰你！

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Yes, the first and most
important step to becoming
beautiful is to realize and
accept your gorgeousness.
Confidence first, then beauty.
Never the other way around.
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
是的，變得美麗的第一步，也是最重要的一步，就是意識到並接受自己的美貌。
自信在先，美麗在後。
絕不能本末倒置。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Now that you've established
the proper attitude on beauty,
it's time for you to learn an
advanced technique of- shall
we say- enticement. I know an
expert that I highly recommend.
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
既然你已經確立了正確的美學態度，是時候學習一種高階技巧了——姑且稱之為“魅惑”吧。
我認識一位非常推薦的大師。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Go and find my sister
in Prontera Chruch. If you
mention me by name, she
should be willing to teach
you. I'd do it myself, but I need to enjoy my new Crystal Mirror~
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
去普隆德拉教堂找我的姐姐。
如果你提到我的名字，她應該會願意教你。
我自己也想教，但我得享受我的新水晶鏡子~

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt figures that she'd
keep your mirror.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看來她會把你的鏡子收著呢。^000000

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Ah, such a glamorous
face and figure. My
beauty is incompara--
Oh! It's you. So did my
sister in Prontera Church
teach you anything yet?
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
啊，多麼迷人的臉龐和身材。我的美貌是無與倫比的——
哦！是你啊。那麼，普隆德拉教堂的姐姐教你了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Ah, so were you
able to find Aelle?
Were you able to learn
anything from her?
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
啊，那你找到艾勒了嗎？
你從她那裡學到什麼了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, I only learned
about winks, but not so
much as how to do them.
She... She got drunk and
couldn't teach me more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實，我只學到了關於眨眼的知識，但沒學到怎麼眨眼。
她...她喝醉了，沒法教我更多了。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Oh, I should have known
this would happen. Oh,
well, I guess there's no way
around it now. But you should
know that gettng my sister
drunk... is punishable.
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
哦，我就知道會發生這種事。唉，算了，現在也沒辦法了。但你應該知道，讓我姐姐喝醉...是要受罰的。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Bam!
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
啪！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
?!
What the
hell was that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
？！
那是什麼鬼東西？

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Now, a true Dancer should
be able to figure out the
secret to winking on her
own. But since I'm such
a kind woman, I will deign
to explain it to you. Ho-ho~
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
好了，真正的舞娘應該能自己悟出眨眼的秘訣。
但既然我這麼善良，我就大發慈悲地解釋一下吧。呵呵~

scripts.text:
^3355FFKind woman...?
But she just hit you!
Lightly, of course, but
still, a smack is a smack.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF善良的女人...？
但她剛才打你了！
雖然很輕，但打就是打。^000000

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Alright, the secret to
proper winking is to allow
your eyelid to seductively
move to a natural rhythm.
Close your eye for a second, then open it slowly to this count.
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
好了，正確眨眼的秘訣，是讓眼瞼以自然的節奏充滿誘惑力地移動。
閉上一隻眼睛一秒，然後慢慢睜開，跟著數。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Un, deux, trois~
Look at me, do it
like this. Un, deux, trois~
Now, let me see you try it.
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
一，二，三~
看著我，像這樣。一，二，三~
現在，讓我看看你試試。

scripts.text: Un deux trois~-
scripts.translation: 一 二 三~

scripts.text: Un, doux trois~
scripts.translation: 一，耳，三~

scripts.text: Un, deux, trois~
scripts.translation: 一，二，三~

scripts.text:
[Canell]
No, no!
That's wrong,
completely wrong!
Can't you do it right?!
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
不，不！
錯了，完全錯了！
你就不能做對一次嗎？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
O-ow!
P-please...!
Not the whip again!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好...好痛！
求...求你...！
別再拿鞭子抽我了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Un, deux, trois~

[Canell]
Great, that's exactly
how you do it. Now,
don't forget, the elements
of rhythm and naturalness
are absolutely essential to
this technique of enticement.
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
很好，就是這樣。
記住，節奏感和自然感是這項魅惑技巧的絕對要素。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Now that you've mastered
the art of winking, you.
should know that you cannot
allure those who are much
stronger than you. So your
winks won't work on everyone.
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
既然你已經掌握了眨眼的藝術，你就應該知道，你無法魅惑比你強大得多的人。
所以，你的眨眼並非對所有人都有效。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Of course, my winks don't
have that drawback. Ho-ho~
Anyway, it's time for us to part now. I hope that you grow to
become a more glamorous and charming dancer in days to come.
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
當然，我的眨眼沒有這個缺點。呵呵~
好了，我們要分別了。希望未來你能成長為更迷人、更有魅力的舞娘。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have finally learned
the Charming Wink skill.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你終於學會了眨眼之誘技能。^000000

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Hm...?
Is there anything
more you wanted to
ask me? Ah, you must
be mesmerized by my
beauty, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
嗯...？
還有什麼想問我的嗎？
啊，你一定是被我的美貌迷住了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Oh, to be so beautiful
must be a sin! I should
work in Prontera Church,
just like my sister, to
pray for forgiveness~
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
哦，長得這麼漂亮一定是種罪過吧！我應該像我姐姐一樣在普隆德拉教堂工作，祈求寬恕~

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Hm? Oh, I remember you!
A Gypsy now, I see~ That
look suits you. Now, I'm
sure you've forgotten a few
things since transcending,
am I right? Watch this wink...
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
嗯？哦，我想起來了！
現在是冷豔舞姬了呢~
這個造型很適合你。我想你轉職後肯定忘了不少東西，對吧？看好了，這個眨眼...

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Remember now? It's all
in the natural, seductive
and rhythmic movement of
the eyelid. I hope you use
your Charming Wink to let
your inner beauty shine~
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
想起來了嗎？關鍵在於眼瞼自然、誘惑且富有節奏感的運動。
希望你能用眨眼之誘展現你內在的美~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have learned the
Charming Wink skill.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你學會了眨眼之誘技能。^000000

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Oh, you're such an
adorable little girl! Ah,
I'm sorry, but when you
become a lady at, oh, I don't
know, Job Level 40, then I'll
be able to teach you something~
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
哦，你真是個可愛的小女孩！啊，抱歉，但等你到了，嗯，職業等級40，成為一位女士時，我就能教你一些東西了~

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Oh, what a cute
little girl~! Such
a chubby lil' belly,
so cuuuuuuuuuuute~
scripts.translation:
[卡內爾]
哦，多麼可愛的小女孩~！
這麼圓滾滾的小肚子，好...好...可...愛...~

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Hey there,
handsome~
^333333*Wink~*^000000

^3355FFStrangely enough,
her wink has made
your heart throb.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF奇怪的是，她的眨眼讓你的心怦怦直跳。^000000

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Pssst, hey! I got
some cheap, but slightly
illegal, warps to the Orc
Dungeon, Glast Heim
and the Dead Pit. So
you want in on this?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
噓，嘿！我搞到了一些便宜但有點非法的傳送，去獸人地下城、葛拉斯特海姆和死坑。你想參與嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, um, I'm here
to look for somebody.
You wouldn't happen
to know Canelle's
sister, would you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實，嗯，我是來找人的。
你碰巧認識卡內爾的姐姐嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Ah, so my stuck up
sister sent you, huh?
I should have known,
judging from your clothes.
So you want to become a
more alluring performer, eh?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
啊，原來是我那個高傲的妹妹派你來的啊？
看你的穿著我就知道了。
所以你想成為更有魅力的表演者，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Awww...
That's disappointing.
So... You didn't come
here to buy these warps?
You sure you don't want any?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哎呀...
真讓人失望。
那麼...你不是來買這些傳送的？
你確定不要嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Okay, okay...
So you came for me to
teach you some enticement
technique or something, right?
Huh. Well, this lecture I give?
It's long and complicated.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
好好好...
所以你是來找我教你一些魅惑技巧的，對吧？
哼。不過，我這堂課可是又長又複雜的。

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Talking and explaining
all of the intricate details
for so long will definitely
parch my throat. So first, you
gotta bring me a refreshing
drink before we can begin...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
要是把那些錯綜複雜的細節都講一遍，我的喉嚨肯定會幹渴的。
所以，在開始之前，你得先給我弄點清爽的飲料...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... Okay.
Alright, I guess
I can spare a potion
or two, or maybe bring
back a bottle of juic--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦...好的。
好吧，我想我可以拿出一兩瓶藥水，或者帶瓶果汁回來--

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Whoa, whoa, none of
that junk! I want to
have a real drink.
You know, something
more... ^FF0000Alcohol^000000ic.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哇，別，那種垃圾不要！
我要喝真正的酒。
你知道的，那種更...^FF0000酒精^000000含量高的。

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Oh, and I need some
snacks to sustain all of
my teaching energy! Yeah,
some yummy fruit on a plate
and some cookies too!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哦，我還需要一些零食來補充我教學的能量！
對，盤子裡放些美味的水果，再加點餅乾！

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Soooo, I wanna eat
^FF00001 Apple^000000, ^FF00003 Bananas^000000 and
^FF00005 Well-Baked Cookies^000000. Ah,
make sure you bring ^FF0000China^000000
to serve them on, and don't
forget the ^FF0000Alcohol^000000, okay?

[Aelle]
One last thing...!
Don't let anyone here
in the church know what
we're doing. I don't wanna
get in too much trouble!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
最後一件事...！
別讓教堂裡的任何人知道我們在做什麼。
我可不想惹太多麻煩！

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Great, you've brought
the food! It's a good thing
I'm famished because
I'm going to finish it all!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
太好了，你把食物帶來了！
幸好我餓壞了，因為我要把它們全部吃光！

scripts.text:
^3355FFAelle devoured the
food like a ravenous,
hungry beast that had
been deprived for too long.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF艾勒像一隻飢餓已久的野獸，狼吞虎嚥地吃光了食物。^000000

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
That was sooo good!
I haven't eaten so much
in such a long time! Then
again, you don't get many
chances to pig out in church.
Ah, that's right, the lesson!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
太好吃了！
我好久沒吃這麼多了！
不過話說回來，在教堂裡很少有機會大吃一頓。
啊，對了，課程！

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Now, the easiest, most
subtle and most appealing
gesture of all time is the
^FF0000wink^000000. It's saved me in times
of crisis, and mastering it
will enhance your charms.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
現在，最簡單、最微妙也最迷人的動作就是^FF0000眨眼^000000。它曾在危機時刻救過我，掌握它將會提升你的魅力。

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
To the untrained eye,
the wink only looks like
a simple movement, right?
You close one eye, and then
you reopen that eye. But if
you do it right... If you...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
對於未經訓練的人來說，眨眼看起來只是一個簡單的動作，對吧？
你閉上一隻眼睛，然後再睜開。但如果你做對了...如果你...

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Oh, it's been so long
since I've had so much
to drink! Ugh, f-feeling
kinda--anyway, j-just close
and yer-- ^333333*burp*^000000 winking
is so so so so eeeeeasy~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哦，我已經很久沒有喝這麼多酒了！唔，感-感覺有點--總之，只-只需閉上再-- ^333333*打嗝*^000000眨眼是非常非常非常非常簡-單-的~

scripts.text:
[Drunken Aelle]
Do it! Copy me as
I do it! Wink, j-just
like this, okay? Y' see?
^333333*Wiiiiiiiiiiiiiink*^000000
scripts.translation:
[喝醉的艾勒]
做吧！像我這樣模仿我！眨眼，就-就像這樣，好嗎？看到了嗎？
^333333*眨-眼-~*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wh-whoa...
That was...
It's so beautiful!
And all with just
a simple wink!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇-哇...
那真是...
太美了！
僅僅是一個簡單的眨眼！

scripts.text:
[Totally Drunk Aelle]
Y-yea... The...
The secret ish...
*Urp* It'sh in the--
Bwahahahaahah!
It's all spinning!
scripts.translation:
[爛醉的艾勒]
是-是的...那個...
秘密是...
*嗝* 它在於--
哇哈哈哈！
一切都轉起來了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIn her drunken stupor,
Aelle pummels you with
her fists and laughs
maniacally to herself.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在醉意朦朧中，艾勒用拳頭捶打你，並對著自己狂笑。^000000

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
How can you expect
me to teach you anything
if I faint in the middle of
the lesson? That's right,
I'll need some nourishing,
yet delicious, snacks to eat~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
如果我在講課中途暈倒，你怎麼指望我教你任何東西？
沒錯，我需要一些既營養又美味的零食來吃~

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Soooo, I wanna eat
^FF00001 Apple^000000, ^FF00003 Bananas^000000 and
^FF00005 Well-Baked Cookies^000000. Ah,
make sure you bring ^FF0000China^000000
to serve them on, and don't
forget the ^FF0000Alcohol^000000, okay?

[{0}]
You still haven't told
me the secret to making
a simple wink have so
much provocative charm.
I really need to--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你還沒告訴我，如何讓一個簡單的眨眼擁有如此誘人的魅力。
我真的需要--

scripts.text:
[Totally Hammered Aelle]
ZzzZzz... Huh?
Yesh, I know, I'm...
I'm a geeenius, yeah...
...ZzzzZzzzZzZzzzZZZzz...
scripts.translation:
[不省人事的艾勒]
ZzzZzz...嗯？
是的，我知道，我是...
我是天才，是的...
...ZzzzZzzzZzZzzzZZZzz...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W-wake up!
I went through
all this trouble to
learn this technique!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
快...快醒醒！
我費了這麼大勁才學會這項技巧！

scripts.text:
[Annoyed Aelle]
SHADDUP!
I'M SHLEEEEEPY!
G-go away. Talk to
Canell, my sister...
...ZzzzzZzZZZzzzZZ....
scripts.translation:
[惱火的艾勒]
閉嘴！
我困死了！
走...走開。去找我妹妹卡內爾吧...
...ZzzzzZzZZZzzzZZ....

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Aelle, I really
need you to teach
me everything else
I need to know about
winking and--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
艾勒，我真的需要你教我關於眨眼技巧的其他所有知識，還有--

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
^333333*Hiccup*^000000 Zzz--wha?
I need ta teach you
to go'way. Talk to my
sister, too tired now.
Go lemme alone girl!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
^333333*打嗝*^000000 Zzz--什麼？
我得教你怎麼滾蛋。去找我妹妹吧，我現在太累了。
別纏著我了，女孩！

scripts.text:
[Sober Aelle]
Ohhh...
H-headache...
scripts.translation:
[清醒的艾勒]
噢...
頭好痛...

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Oh, wow, look at you!
I can tell that you've
become much more
beautiful. Yes, you're
more elegant and refined
than I can remember.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哇，看看你！
我看得出你變得更漂亮了。是的，你比我記憶中的樣子更優雅、更精緻。

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Always believe in your
beauty, wield your charm
like a weapon... And anything
you desire in this world can
be yours! Bwahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
永遠相信你的美麗，像使用武器一樣運用你的魅力...
這樣，這個世界上你想要的任何東西都能屬於你！哇哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Pssst, hey! I got
some cheap, but slightly
illegal, warps to the Orc
Dungeon, Glast Heim
and the Dead Pit. So
you want in on this?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
噓，嘿！我搞到了一些便宜但有點非法的傳送，去獸人地下城、葛拉斯特海姆和死坑。你想參與嗎？

scripts.text:
[??????]
Sister Aelle...
Are you still trying
to sell illegal warps
again? Sister Aelle?
scripts.translation:
[??????]
艾勒修女...
你又在試圖販賣非法傳送服務嗎？
艾勒修女？

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Oh crap, it's the pastor!
Shhh, if anybody asks you,
I wasn't doing anything!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
糟糕，是牧師來了！
噓，如果有人問起，就說我什麼都沒做！

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Thanks, hon...
I know you can
keep my contraband
our little secret. ^333333*Wink*^000000
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
謝了，親愛的...
我知道你能替我保守這個關於違禁品的小秘密。^333333*眨眼*^000000
